name: ballerinax/copybook
description: This package provides APIs to convert Cobol Copybook data to JSON or Ballerina records and vice versa.
readme:
## Package Overview

This package provides APIs to convert Cobol Copybook data to JSON or Ballerina records and vice versa.

typeDefs.name: Encoding
typeDefs.description: Represents the encoding types used for the input or output byte arrays.

typeDefs.name: Converter
typeDefs.description: Initializes the converter with a schema.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the converter with a schema.

parameters.name: schemaFilePath
parameters.description: The path of the copybook file

functions.name: toBytes
functions.description: Converts the provided record or map<json> value to bytes.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The JSON value that needs to be converted as copybook data

parameters.name: targetRecordName
parameters.description:
The name of the copybook record definition in the copybook. This parameter must be a string
if the provided schema file contains more than one copybook record type definition

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: The encoding of the output bytes array. Default is ASCII

return.description: The converted byte array. In case of an error, a `copybook:Error` is is returned

functions.name: fromBytes
functions.description: Converts the given copybook bytes to a Ballerina record.

parameters.name: bytes
parameters.description: Bytes array that needs to be converted to a record value

parameters.name: targetRecordName
parameters.description:
The name of the copybook record definition in the copybook. This parameter must be a string
if the provided schema file contains more than one copybook record type definition

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: The encoding of the input bytes array. Default is ASCII

return.description: A record value on success, a `copybook:Error` in case of coercion errors
